note: Regression expectations for scripts/eval_check.py. Each corpus pins repo + rev (commit SHA) and its checkout dir under the corpus base (~ by default, or $TRACE_CORPUS_BASE / --corpus-base); scripts/fetch_corpora.py checks the pinned revisions out and eval_check.py refuses a checkout at any other revision. 'exact' must match; 'band' compares abs(actual-expected) <= N; 'min' requires actual >= N. Site checks count distinct callee NAMES at one dispatch call_site (caller name LIKE, line). Values were re-captured 2026-09-04 on top of af26c2b (#39, the `...` punctuator fix) for the `->*` punctuator fix (#37), which moves the camera corpus by exactly one fabricated symbol and its one edge: `dps.h:40`'s `(server.get()->*func)(cmd)` used to split into `-> *`, and tree-sitter recovered `*func` as a callee, interning an external function named after the template parameter `func`. Earlier on that day the same three corpora were captured for the `...` punctuator fix (#28): the parse-diagnostic counts drop in all three corpora (27 files stop failing to parse), and the camera bulk totals move because `camera_napi_param_parser.h` now parses, so its members carry qualified names instead of the unqualified free functions the ERROR node used to leave behind. Earlier captures: 2026-09-04 on 168e643 for the gMock declaration fallbacks (#15, camera only), and 2026-09-03 on 9d15520 ('Lex C++11 raw string literals and prefixed/user-defined literals as one token', #14/#24), after the file-scoped conditional fence, `#` stringize, and preprocessor-diagnostics export fixes (#8, #13, #20) at the pinned revisions (see docs/EVAL_REPORT.md); bulk function/edge totals drift a little run-to-run (parallel index), correctness numbers do not. Re-captured 2026-09-04 on top of 9979676 (#47) for the conversion-operator fix (#46): hiview functions 11464 -> 11463 (external 3692 -> 3691) and camera 25891 -> 25884 (external 6918 -> 6911). All of it is fabricated symbols collapsing into the real ones -- an `FFI_EXPORT <type> f(...)` entry point whose attribute macro has no `#define` in the include path makes tree-sitter recover the return type and the name under a MISSING `::`, and the glued spelling was interned alongside the real symbol. Edges, defined-function counts and diagnostics do not move in any corpus, and hdf does not move at all; the new exact probes pin the malformed names at zero, since the bands are far too wide to catch a handful of symbols on their own. A second review pass then found that the same function's `<...>` stripping truncated every `operator<` / `<=` / `<<` / `<=>` to the bare keyword `operator`, collapsing a class's comparison operators into one symbol: 14 such rows across the three corpora (hdf 7, hiview 5, camera 2) become correctly-spelled members, moving hiview functions to 11465 (defined 7774) and camera to 25885 (defined 18974); hdf's row count is unchanged because the collapse renamed rather than merged there. Re-verified 2026-09-05 on top of ebb2ddb for eleven review follow-ups on #46 (conversion operators behind a leading attribute macro, in-class and out-of-class; nullary definitions behind a trailing one; members wearing an unknown macro on both sides, plain and conversion; both attribute-macro repairs missed whenever a scope nested the recovery's mark below the top `qualified_identifier`; `resolve_type_id`'s stale `Unknown` fallback; conversion targets losing the scopes and template arguments that tell two of them apart; function-pointer targets lowering as plain pointers; and standard/GNU attributes supplying the member name). Ten of the eleven do not occur in the pinned corpora and leave all three byte-identical, so they are covered by unit tests only. The eleventh does: a `[[deprecated]]` or `__attribute__((...))` parses cleanly but held an identifier in front of the declaration that the member walk took, collapsing every annotated member of a class into one symbol -- camera's `CameraInput` came down to a single `CameraInput::deprecated`. Removing 7 such phantoms (`CameraDevice`, `CameraInput`, `CameraManager`, `HCameraService`, `PhotoOutput` under `deprecated`; `SteadyClock`, `TaskManager` under a GNU `visibility`) restores 26 real members, all undefined prototypes, so camera moves 25885 -> 25904 total and 6911 -> 6930 external with functions_defined unchanged at 18974, and edges, arg-flow and diagnostics unchanged; hdf and hiview hold no attribute-named member either way and do not move. The +19 is far inside the +-120 band, so an exact probe pinning attribute-named members at zero was added to each corpus, plus one pinning `CameraInput::LockForControl` under its own name. Note that hiview's function totals reproduce as 11456/7776/3680 on some machines rather than the 11465/7774/3691 pinned here -- inside the band, stable across job counts, with files and every correctness number matching exactly. The large hdf/camera edge growth is the expansion-site LineMap attribution fix shipped with #13: call sites are deduped on (file, line, col, callee), so macro-expanded sites that used to collide on their #define coordinates are now distinct.

probes.name: flow_graph_nodes
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_nodes

probes.name: arg_flow_rows_per_call_edge
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arg_flow_edges a JOIN call_sites cs ON cs.id=a.call_site_id

probes.name: no member indexed under a declarator fragment (#46: a conversion operator's `operator_cast` declarator was unknown to both member walks, so `operator bool() const {...}` fell out of a generic walk as `X::()const`; the real `operator()` stays, and so does a conversion whose target is a function pointer or reference — `X::operator void(*)` is the correct name for one)
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM functions WHERE name GLOB '*(*' AND name NOT GLOB '*operator()' AND name NOT GLOB '*operator *(*'

probes.name: no member indexed under the bare keyword `operator` (#46: `normalize_qualified` stripped `<...>` as a template-argument span, truncating the whole `operator<` / `<=` / `<<` / `<=>` family to the keyword and collapsing a class's comparison operators into one symbol)
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM functions WHERE name='operator' OR name GLOB '*::operator'

probes.name: no member indexed under a standard attribute (#46 review: `[[deprecated]] void LockForControl();` parses cleanly -- no error recovery involved -- but the attribute holds an identifier in front of the declaration and the member walk took it, collapsing every annotated member of a class into one symbol; camera lost 26 `CameraInput` / `CameraManager` members to 7 such phantoms)
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM functions WHERE name GLOB '*::deprecated' OR name GLOB '*::nodiscard' OR name GLOB '*::maybe_unused' OR name GLOB '*::noreturn' OR name GLOB '*::fallthrough' OR name GLOB '*::visibility' OR name GLOB '*::dllexport' OR name GLOB '*::dllimport'

probes.name: conversion operator carries its `operator T` name (#46: `AutoPtr::operator T*() const` was indexed as `operatorT*()const`; scoped to the name rather than the file so a moved path cannot make this pass vacuously)
probes.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM functions WHERE name='OHOS::HDI::AutoPtr::operator T*'
